components.name: Accordion
components.intent: Expand or collapse content sections
components.markup_template:
<section class="accordion">
  <details open>
    <summary>Overview</summary>
    <section>Overview content.</section>
  </details>
  <details>
    <summary>More</summary>
    <section>More content.</section>
  </details>
  <details aria-disabled="true">
    <summary>Unavailable</summary>
    <section>Unavailable content.</section>
  </details>
</section>
components.composition_rules: Open: details has open; closed: omit open. aria-disabled=true prevents toggling. One item opens at a time; data-multiple on .accordion allows several. Wrong: replace native details/summary with div/button and invented data-state attributes.

components.name: Alert
components.intent: Show persistent inline warnings and notices
components.markup_template:
Heads up!

You can add components and dependencies to your app.
components.composition_rules: Use data-variant="destructive" for errors. Optional direct child footer aligns actions inline-end. Wrong: use role="alert" on a div without the alert class or omit the section wrapper for body text.

components.name: Alert Dialog
components.intent: Interrupt with a destructive confirmation
components.markup_template:
Are you absolutely sure?

This action cannot be undone.
components.composition_rules: Native dialog with alert-dialog class; no Basecoat JS. Omit dismiss controls when the user must choose explicitly. Wire showModal() from a trigger; check returnValue on close. Wrong: use class="dialog" alone or backdrop click to dismiss a destructive confirm.

components.name: Aspect Ratio
components.intent: Constrain content to a specific ratio such as video or square
components.composition_rules: Constrain images, videos, and embedded frames to defined aspect ratios (e.g. aspect-video, aspect-square). Use standard Tailwind v4 aspect utilities.

components.name: Avatar
components.intent: Display a portrait or initials fallback
components.markup_template: CN
components.composition_rules: Image first, fallback span after. data-size="sm" or data-size="lg" for alternate sizes. avatar-badge for status dot. avatar-group wraps overlapping avatars. Wrong: put initials before img or omit alt on the image.

components.name: Badge
components.intent: Display compact status or a short label
components.markup_template: Active
components.composition_rules: Use short text for status. Do not rely on color alone or use a badge as a primary action.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.intent: Show hierarchy from home to current page
components.markup_template:
1. Home
  2. Current
components.composition_rules: nav.breadcrumb with aria-label="Breadcrumb". Mark current page with aria-current="page". Separators use li[aria-hidden="true"]. Wrong: use a div instead of nav/ol or skip aria-current on the current item.

components.name: Button
components.intent: Trigger an action or submit a form
components.markup_template: <button type="button" class="btn">Save changes</button>
components.composition_rules: One primary action per task group. Use data-variant="outline" for Cancel; group actions with gap-2 and separate the group with gap-6.

components.name: Button Group
components.intent: Group related segmented buttons
components.composition_rules: Wrap related btn controls sharing outer radius. data-orientation="vertical" stacks controls. hr[role="separator"] divides groups. Wrong: nest unrelated standalone buttons without the button-group wrapper.

components.name: Calendar
components.intent: Display monthly date grid and enable date navigation
components.markup_template:
February 2026

SuMoTuWeThFrSa
components.composition_rules: Render monthly date grids using 7-column CSS grid. Day action buttons must declare aria-label for accessibility. Date selection and range states are managed by host logic.

components.name: Card
components.intent: Group a self-contained content section
components.markup_template:
Summary

Supporting context.

Content
components.composition_rules: Never nest a card inside a card. Use flat sections or dividers for inner groups. Keep one primary action per card.

components.name: Carousel
components.intent: Navigate horizontally through featured slides or cards
components.markup_template:
Slide 1

First featured item description.

Slide 2

Second featured item description.
components.composition_rules: CSS scroll snap provides native horizontal carousels without heavy JavaScript libraries. Provide aria-label on navigation controls.

components.name: Chart
components.intent: Visualize numeric data as a chart
components.markup_template: A: 3; B: 5.
components.composition_rules: Requires app-supplied Chart.js on window.Chart before initialization. Basecoat does not bundle it. Use a canvas inside .chart with an accessible label and text alternative. No open/closed/disabled state. Wrong: assume data-chart-data or initAll() initializes charts; call basecoat.chart() explicitly.

components.name: Checkbox
components.intent: Toggle an independent boolean option
components.composition_rules: Checkbox uses class="input" on input[type="checkbox"]. Pair with field and label. data-disabled on field mirrors disabled input. Wrong: add role="checkbox" on a div or omit the label association.

components.name: Collapsible
components.intent: Expand or collapse content sections with an interactive trigger
components.markup_template:
Can I customize the styling?
Yes! Basecoat uses standard Tailwind v4 classes and native HTML.
components.composition_rules: Native details and summary elements provide accessible collapsible sections without script dependencies. Do not nest card inside details.

components.name: Combobox
components.intent: Filter options and select a value
components.markup_template:
Alpha
Beta
components.composition_rules: Closed: aria-expanded=false, aria-hidden=true; open reverses both. Runtime manages aria-selected, aria-activedescendant and option aria-hidden for filtering. Disable text input with disabled; options with aria-disabled=true. Wrong: replace the hidden value input with a name on the search input.

components.name: Command
components.intent: Search and invoke commands
components.markup_template:
Open
Unavailable
components.composition_rules: Standalone command stays expanded. Modal variant: dialog.command-dialog wraps .command; use showModal()/close(). Disabled items: aria-disabled=true. Runtime manages active, aria-activedescendant and filtered aria-hidden. Bind application actions. Wrong: use listbox/option instead of menu/menuitem.

components.name: Context Menu
components.intent: Display contextual actions triggered by secondary click
components.markup_template:
Right click here to open
Back
Reload
components.composition_rules: Context menus trigger on secondary pointer click. Position dynamically using coordinates in host client scripts.

components.name: Data Table
components.intent: Display tabular data with structured rows and column headers
components.markup_template:
Invoice Status Amount
INV-001 Paid $250.00
components.composition_rules: Always enclose table inside an overflow-x-auto container. Align numeric currency and metric columns to the right.

components.name: Date Picker
components.intent: Select a date from an input control
components.composition_rules: Pair date input with explicit label for accessibility. Keep input styling consistent with Basecoat input tokens.

components.name: Dialog
components.intent: Request focused input or destructive confirmation
components.markup_template:
Confirm action

Review the consequences before continuing.
components.composition_rules: Native dialog: no Basecoat JS. Listen for close and check returnValue === 'confirm' before performing the action; this template only closes. Keep Cancel focused; no nested card.

components.name: Drawer
components.intent: Open a modal panel from a screen edge
components.markup_template:
Details

Panel content.
components.composition_rules: showModal() sets native open; close() animates with data-closing then clears open. Keep one inner surface. Escape/backdrop close via the controller. Native disabled blocks trigger buttons; no drawer disabled state. Wrong: use a div.drawer or invent data-open-drawer behavior.

components.name: Dropdown Menu
components.intent: Reveal contextual actions from a trigger
components.composition_rules: Keep trigger, popover and menu in one wrapper with matching IDs. Preserve menu roles and keyboard behavior. Bind application actions to menu items.

components.name: Empty
components.intent: Explain an empty state and offer a next step
components.markup_template:
No records yet

Create a record to get started.
components.composition_rules: Explain why content is absent and offer one useful next action. Keep the state in its content region; do not wrap it in nested cards.

components.name: Field
components.intent: Stack label, control, and helper text
components.markup_template: Your public display username.
components.composition_rules: One control per field. data-orientation="vertical"|"horizontal"|"inline". Label for matches control id. Control aria-describedby references field-description and field-error IDs. Wrap multiple related fields in field-group.

components.name: Field Group
components.intent: Group related fields with semantic fieldset and legend
components.markup_template:
Profile Settings

Displayed on your public profile.

Please enter a valid email address.
components.composition_rules: Group related fields in field-group with semantic fieldset and field-legend. Support data-orientation="vertical"|"horizontal"|"inline". Dual data-invalid and aria-invalid on validation errors.

components.name: Form
components.intent: Structure input submission with labeled fields and actions
components.markup_template: This is your public display name.
components.composition_rules: Structure forms with explicit labels, descriptive helper text, and single primary submit actions.

components.name: Hover Card
components.intent: Preview detailed profile or entity content on pointer hover
components.markup_template:
@basecoat
BC

Basecoat UI

Minimalist UI primitives built with Tailwind CSS v4.
components.composition_rules: Hover cards provide rich secondary previews on pointer hover. Ensure interactive content remains reachable via focus.

components.name: Input
components.intent: Enter a single text value
components.markup_template: Use your work email.
components.composition_rules: Keep the label visible. Use gap-2 within each field, gap-4 between fields and gap-6 before actions. Associate errors using aria-describedby and aria-invalid.

components.name: Input Group
components.intent: Combine an input with inline addons
components.markup_template: Search 12 results
components.composition_rules: Native input/textarea/select stay borderless children. data-align="start|end" places addons; data-orientation="vertical" uses header/footer rows. Wrong: wrap the control outside input-group or omit aria-hidden on decorative icons.

components.name: Input OTP
components.intent: Enter one-time passcode verification digits into discrete inputs
components.composition_rules: One-time passcode inputs require discrete character cells with individual aria-label attributes and role="group".

components.name: Item
components.intent: Display one row of content in a list
components.markup_template:
Record title

Supporting details.
components.composition_rules: One item is one row inside item-group, not a card grid. Repeat sibling items for a list; keep content in section and trailing actions in aside.

components.name: Kbd
components.intent: Render keyboard shortcut key caps
components.markup_template: Ctrl+K
components.composition_rules: Use kbd.kbd per key cap. Group combos with inline-flex and + text between keys. Wrong: style shortcuts with code or span alone without the kbd class.

components.name: Label
components.intent: Name a form control accessibly
components.markup_template: <label class="label" for="email">Your email address</label>
components.composition_rules: Apply label class on native label. for must match control id. Can wrap checkbox/radio inside label. Wrong: replace label with a bare span for visible field names.

components.name: Menubar
components.intent: Present horizontal top-level desktop application menu commands
components.composition_rules: Declare role="menubar" with menuitem children. Group application level commands horizontally.

components.name: Native Select
components.intent: Choose a value with a native select
components.markup_template:
<select class="select" aria-label="Fruit">
  <option value="">Select a fruit</option>
  <option value="apple">Apple</option>
  <option value="banana">Banana</option>
</select>
components.composition_rules: Native select uses class="select" (not the JS custom select). Provide aria-label or an associated label. disabled on select blocks interaction. Wrong: reuse the custom .select div/listbox markup for a native element.

components.name: Navigation Menu
components.intent: Display primary website section navigation links
components.markup_template: Getting Started Components Documentation
components.composition_rules: Navigation landmark must declare an aria-label to differentiate from sidebar or footer navigation links.

components.name: Pagination
components.intent: Navigate across paginated list pages with previous and next controls
components.markup_template: 1 2 3
components.composition_rules: Pagination navigation landmark requires aria-label. Active page button uses data-variant="outline" while sibling links use ghost.

components.name: Popover
components.intent: Reveal contextual content beside a trigger
components.markup_template:
Details

Supporting information.
components.composition_rules: Closed: trigger aria-expanded=false, content aria-hidden=true; open reverses both. Native disabled on the trigger blocks activation. Wrong: wrap the trigger or data-popover in another element; both must be direct children of .popover.

components.name: Progress
components.intent: Show determinate task completion
components.composition_rules: One child span width matches aria-valuenow. Set aria-label or aria-labelledby. Wrong: use progress element without the progress class or omit aria-valuenow on a determinate bar.

components.name: Radio Group
components.intent: Choose one option from a small set
components.composition_rules: Radios use class="input" with a shared name. Wrap in role="radiogroup" or fieldset with legend. field+section adds descriptions. Wrong: give each radio a different name or skip the group landmark.

components.name: Resizable
components.intent: Split panels with an interactive draggable divider handle
components.markup_template:
Panel One
Panel Two
components.composition_rules: Use flex containers with divider separator handles. Handle dragging logic is implemented in client script.

components.name: Scroll Area
components.intent: Style a bounded overflow region
components.markup_template: Your scrollable content here.
components.composition_rules: Apply scrollbar or scrollbar-sm on an element that already uses overflow-auto/y/x. CSS-only; no JS wrapper. Wrong: expect scroll-area to create overflow without overflow utilities on the same node.

components.name: Segmented Toggle
components.intent: Choose one date or filter option from a pill radio group
components.composition_rules: Radio-backed pill control: role=radiogroup, data-variant=pill, shared radio name, three options. Reuses radio-group semantics without Chart.js. Wrong: use button-group alone without radios for exclusive selection.

components.name: Select
components.intent: Choose a value from a list
components.markup_template:
Alpha
Beta
components.composition_rules: Closed: aria-expanded=false, aria-hidden=true; open reverses both. Selected option: aria-selected=true; runtime sets aria-activedescendant. Disable trigger with disabled; options with aria-disabled=true. Wrong: omit the direct-child hidden input or trigger span.

components.name: Separator
components.intent: Visually separate sections with a horizontal or vertical divider line
components.markup_template:
Basecoat UI

Minimalist primitives for web applications.

Docs
Source
components.composition_rules: Separators provide visual division between elements. Declare role="separator" and aria-orientation="vertical" when dividing horizontally.

components.name: Sheet
components.intent: Slide-over secondary panel anchored to viewport edge
components.markup_template:
Sheet Panel

Panel content goes here.
components.composition_rules: Native dialog provides modal focus trap and escape handling for off-canvas side sheets. Use fixed edge anchoring.

components.name: Sidebar
components.intent: Show collapsible application navigation
components.markup_template: • Home
components.composition_rules: open()/close()/toggle() manage aria-hidden and inert: closed=true+inert; open=false without inert. Initial state uses data-initial-open and data-initial-mobile-open. Native disabled blocks buttons. Keep page content immediately after .sidebar. Wrong: invent data-sidebar-toggle; bind the trigger to toggle().

components.name: Skeleton
components.intent: Placeholder blocks while content loads
components.composition_rules: skeleton plus sizing utilities shapes placeholders. Mark decorative blocks aria-hidden when adjacent text explains loading. Wrong: use skeleton as a live content container without aria-busy on the updating region.

components.name: Slider
components.intent: Pick a numeric value on a range track
components.markup_template: <input type="range" aria-label="Slider" class="input w-full" min="0" max="100" value="50" />
components.composition_rules: Native input[type="range"] with class="input". range.js sets --slider-value on input events. Single thumb only; no vertical or multi-thumb API. Wrong: import basecoat-css/slider or omit the range module while using type="range".

components.name: Sonner
components.intent: Show modern stacked feedback notifications and action alerts
components.markup_template:
Event created

Monday, February 16, 2026 at 9:00 AM
components.composition_rules: Render toast notifications inside an accessible status region. Include concise message and optional single action.

components.name: Spinner
components.intent: Display animated circular loading indicator
components.markup_template: Loading...
components.composition_rules: Provide role="status" and visible or screen-reader text alongside the animated spinner SVG for accessibility.

components.name: SVG Area Chart
components.intent: Render an offline SVG area chart without Chart.js
components.composition_rules: Zero-runtime SVG area chart. No window.Chart or basecoat.chart(). Keep accessible title/desc. Existing chart leaf remains Chart.js-based. Wrong: require Chart.js for this leaf.

components.name: Switch
components.intent: Toggle a boolean setting immediately
components.composition_rules: Switch is input[type="checkbox"] with role="switch" and class="input". checked/disabled/aria-invalid follow native state. data-size="sm" shrinks track. Wrong: use role="switch" on a div or a button element.

components.name: Table
components.intent: Compare structured records in rows and columns
components.markup_template:
Recent invoices
InvoiceAmount
INV-001$250.00
components.composition_rules: Use a table for comparable records; no card per row. Keep labels start-aligned and numbers end-aligned. Place the toolbar gap-4 above. Keep overlays outside the scrolling container.

components.name: Tabs
components.intent: Switch between related views in one context
components.markup_template:
Overview content
History content
components.composition_rules: Use tabs for peer views, not sequential steps. Keep panels flat; use gap-6 between content groups. Preserve matching IDs, hidden state and keyboard navigation.

components.name: Textarea
components.intent: Enter multiline text
components.markup_template: <textarea class="textarea" placeholder="Type your message here"></textarea>
components.composition_rules: textarea class on native textarea; field wrapper styles nested textareas too. disabled and aria-invalid="true" for states. Wrong: use input type="text" for multiline copy or omit label in a field group.

components.name: Theme Switcher
components.intent: Toggle light and dark color mode
components.composition_rules: Requires basecoat runtime for window.basecoat.theme.toggle(). Pair sun/moon SVGs with dark:hidden/dark:block. Add inline pre-CSS themeMode script to avoid flash. Wrong: import basecoat-css/all or a nonexistent theme-switcher module.

components.name: Toast
components.intent: Show a brief notification
components.markup_template:
Saved

Changes saved.
components.composition_rules: Use one #toaster. Open: aria-hidden=false; close() sets true then removes the toast after transition. data-duration=-1 disables timeout. Footer buttons/links dismiss; native disabled blocks buttons. Error category uses role=alert. Wrong: rename #toaster or add a fake data-toast-trigger attribute.

components.name: Toggle
components.intent: Single pressable button that switches between on and off states
components.markup_template:
<button type="button" class="btn" data-variant="outline" data-size="icon" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Toggle italic">
  <svg class="size-4" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><line x1="19" y1="4" x2="10" y2="4"/><line x1="14" y1="20" x2="5" y2="20"/><line x1="15" y1="4" x2="9" y2="20"/></svg>
</button>
components.composition_rules: Two-state toggle button must reflect state with aria-pressed. Provide accessible aria-label on icon-only toggles.

components.name: Toggle Group
components.intent: Group of coordinated toggle buttons for formatting or option choices
components.composition_rules: Group toggle buttons inside role="group" container with aria-label. Maintain individual aria-pressed state on buttons.

components.name: Tooltip
components.intent: Show a brief hint on hover or focus
components.markup_template: <button class="btn" data-variant="outline" data-tooltip="Tooltip text" data-side="bottom" data-align="center">Hover</button>
components.composition_rules: CSS-only: data-tooltip text on the trigger. data-side top|bottom|left|right|inline-start|inline-end; data-align start|center|end. Text only, no portal markup. Wrong: nest a separate tooltip span or invent aria-describedby portals like shadcn Tooltip.
